verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs list a use case of logging into vendor portals and downloading PDF invoices, so downloading files is implied. Run artifacts such as recordings, screenshots and network traffic are captured automatically, though the evidence never says downloaded files are among them. Submitting applications on Lever and Greenhouse hints at uploads, but nothing explicitly documents file upload. Missing for 10: explicit file-upload documentation, documentation that downloaded files are stored and retrievable via API or SDK, any hands-on corroboration of download or upload working.
